requirements.proposed_behavior: Repair specifically identified supported applicable omissions, overstatements or missing disclosures using the same final evidence; retain draft/revised/final versions and current-version grounding/citation checks.
must_not_do: Use runtime benchmark points
Invent unsupported law or unconditional duties
Treat disclosure as substantive point recovery
Silently retrieve or increase budgets during revision
Overwrite first completeness or draft
Infer isolated causal benefit from draft/final alone
confirmation_needed_before_implementatio: External review of repair scope and explicit prototype authorization
Independent DEV evidence of supported omissions plus no-support negative controls
Reviewed legal/support/applicability rubric and budget/isolation feasibility
adoption_confirmation: Repeatable localized recovery across independent held-out cases and production runs
Safety margins and severe-claim gate pass
Bundle/controlled contrast limitations explicit and cost reported

requirements.problem: Weak completeness/self-check calibration; Evidence-aware completeness verification
requirements.proposed_behavior: Separately assess requested scope, applicable evidence support, actual answer coverage and unresolved evidence/conditions; distinguish supported omissions from evidence limits with runtime-only estimates.
must_not_do: Conflate plausible answer with complete
Require every retrieved chunk in answer
Treat relevant evidence as required/applicable
Treat internal complete as gold certified
Turn REFINE into implementation permission
confirmation_needed_before_implementatio: Independent DEV examples of mismatch in both directions and supported omission versus absent evidence
External agreement on scope/status semantics
Review checker information and call-budget feasibility; explicit later authorization
adoption_confirmation: Improved calibration without indiscriminate insufficiency or safety/cost deterioration

requirements.problem: Possible goal persistence from missing aspect → evidence → answer
requirements.proposed_behavior: UNCONFIRMED candidate Aspect Ledger with persistent IDs, orthogonal origin/admission/search/support/applicability/disposition and append-only transitions; explicit unsupported asks require disclosure, inferred unsupported candidates do not force answer content.
must_not_do: Promote Tier C to confirmed problem
Count the single medical diagnostic as confirmation
Force all inferred candidates into answer
Erase aspects after retrieval or dedup
Treat unavailable historical intermediate payload as observed disappearance
confirmation_needed_before_implementatio: At least three distinct independent DEV carry-through cases across at least two task families/scenario clusters, reviewed by two assessors; proposed review floor, not power estimate
Stage-observable supported omissions or undisclosed explicit unresolved asks, with alternative explanations ruled out; medical diagnostic excluded
If historical v1 lacks needed state, mark unobservable and require separately authorized behavior-preserving observation before confirmation
External approval of ledger admission/merge/exclusion safeguards and explicit prototype authorization
adoption_confirmation: Reduced disappearance and better supported/disclosed coverage without overgeneration
Separate R3 causal claim requires isolated contrast; bundle result insufficient

requirements.problem: Evidence Expansion efficiency; More selective / higher-value expansion policy
requirements.proposed_behavior: Authorize bounded targeted searches only for specific evidence gaps; retain candidate/final support gains and losses, applicability and cost; stop when no new applicable value or budget remains.
must_not_do: Delete expansion because aggregate effect weak
Always expand broad/hard queries
Tune on frozen 31 or v2 outputs
Count chunk novelty as legal value
Raise Top-K/rounds/subqueries/context by default
Make causal claims from triggered-only strata
confirmation_needed_before_implementatio: Independent DEV corpus-first search-opportunity and no-value cases
Reviewed novelty/applicability/stop rubric and frozen-reference budget feasibility
D6 audit independent of v2, no retrieval-outcome selection
External implementation authorization
adoption_confirmation: Repeated C→E coverage and answer/adequacy gain in aggregate or predeclared adequately exposed strata

requirements.problem: Hard-query evaluation gap; Separate challenge/hard-query benchmark
requirements.proposed_behavior: Design corpus-first independent challenge construction, legal gold schema and DEV/HOLDOUT separation while retaining the historical benchmark.
must_not_do: Create actual queries or gold now
Select queries because v1 fails
Build gold from v2 output
Copy medical diagnostic into TEST
Expose TEST gold to implementers/runtime
Replace historical benchmark
runtime_inputs: Future strict query-only projection: opaque query_id and exact query string; no dimension metadata
confirmation_needed_before_implementatio: External design review before construction
Phase 5C.4 corpus-first annotation, whole-cluster split and freeze
Independent custodian and evaluator-side gold; implementer DEV-only access
D6 shortfall reported without output-guided substitution
Explicit separate later authorization for dataset construction and runtime implementation
adoption_confirmation: Independent held-out comparison with adequate coverage and recorded limitations

requirements.proposed_behavior: Keep frozen labels and historical benchmark, provenance, paired transitions, macro/micro safety, separate call ledgers and preregistered multi-run/judge uncertainty safeguards.
must_not_do: Relabel frozen A1/A2
Call one replication a variance estimate
Subtract historical replication delta from effects
Best-of-N selection or quality-triggered reruns
Pool points/runs as independent queries
Treat current design checks as deployed isolation
runtime_inputs: runtime corpus/model/retrieval inputs; analysis protocol remains evaluator-side
trace_requirements: separate evaluator join after all production
future_metrics: paired AC deltas and point churn
confirmation_needed_before_implementatio: Safeguard specification retained; KEEP_AS_IS does not authorize other mechanisms
External approval of arms, repeats, metrics/margins and budget/isolation before future TEST
Future offline synthetic leakage and provenance gates before live execution
adoption_confirmation: All scheduled runs retained and sealed before evaluation
No quality-based selection; generation/judge/query uncertainty separated
No causal overclaim on inconclusive evidence
